chunks: And this (so that it may be clear) that your Lord does not destroy towns and cities arbitrarily while the citizens remain unaware.
ai.seo_question: Why does God destroy towns if He is just?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am underscores the principle of divine justice (Adl), clarifying that the ruin of civilizations is never arbitrary but a consequence of collective heedlessness (ghaflah) after warnings have been given. It highlights that God does not destroy communities while they are still in a state of spiritual ignorance or unawareness, ensuring that punishment is proportionate to the degree of their negligence.
